text:
maria: FYI Zenith POC hitting intermittent SSE disconnects. They see JSON.parse errors on the client: 'Unexpected end of JSON input' after ~8-15s of streaming. Can we triage before the afternoon call?

chen: Quick ask - are they using our JS SDK or a custom EventSource? Need request-id from a failing session.

maria: They're on a custom Android WebView EventSource polyfill. Request-ID: rwd-zy-4411. Attached snippet from client logs: `SyntaxError: Unexpected end of JSON input at JSON.parse` and `event data: data: {"choices":[{"delta":{"content":"Hel` (cut off)`.

own: Very likely either proxy buffering or client-side event framing. If the SSE events are split across TCP chunks, naive JSON.parse will fail.

sre-anna: On the infra side I checked rwd-zy-4411: no 429s or auth errors. Connection was established then closed at ~14s with FIN. I want them to run a raw curl -N test to rule out their fronting proxy: `curl -N -H "Accept: text/event-stream" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/stream/chat?request_id=debug-zz"`

chen: Recommend client quick fixes: buffer incoming 'data:' lines until a blank line, then join and strip 'data:' prefixes before JSON.parse. If WebView EventSource is flaky, use fetch streaming and parse by delimiter.

own: I'll also propose we enable short heartbeats from our side for their route (every 15s) to prevent idle timeouts. Will coordinate a short canary.

sre-anna: If they're behind nginx, advise `proxy_buffering off; proxy_http_version 1.1; proxy_read_timeout 3600s;` and `chunked_transfer_encoding on;`. Those settings prevent Nginx from coalescing chunks and timing out long polls.

maria: Sales note: they asked about private deployment lead time and whether that fixes streaming stability. Answer: Private can remove external CDNs/proxies but still needs correct config; plus enterprise procurement will add weeks. Mention on call.

deploy-bot: deploy 2026-04-10T18:05Z: enabled heartbeat-canary for 5% of traffic on /v1/stream/chat.

sre-anna: I'll monitor. If heartbeat increases reconnects we'll rollback. Also ask Zenith to capture raw bytes of first 4KB of the failed stream (hex or base64) and list any intermediate proxies (Cloudflare, Fastly).

maria: Action items: chen -> share inline parsing snippet + recommended fetch streaming example (1h), owen -> draft nginx proxy snippet and heartbeat plan (30m), sre-anna -> monitor canary and collect logs (ongoing). maria -> prep enterprise-ops talking points for call.

chen: Small parsing example for them: `let buf=''; source.addEventListener('message', e=>{ buf += e.data + '\n'; if(buf.endsWith('\n\n')){ const payload = buf.replace(/(^data:\s*)/gm,'').trim(); buf=''; try{ const j = JSON.parse(payload); handle(j);}catch(err){console.error('partial event', err);} } });`

maria: Thanks team. If they can paste a raw snippet of the broken stream we'll prioritize. :thumbsup:
